title: Opportunity Budget Overlay & HC Pricing Sensitivity (Mar 2026)
summary: Working spreadsheet for an "opportunity overlay" approach: temporary headcount and burst capacity investments tied to prospective enterprise deals, with token-pricing sensitivity and candidate ramp assumptions. Purpose: give sales/finance a clear trigger matrix so hiring and commit decisions are opportunity-driven and limited downside.
content:
OVERVIEW:
This sheet tests an "opportunity overlay" construct: rather than assuming permanent headcount bumps for forecasted ARR, we model a small pool of contingent hires and GPU burst capacity that can be activated when the sales pipeline crosses deal-tranche probability thresholds. The goal is to evaluate marginal margin sensitivity to pricing moves and to produce a short actionable trigger matrix (price delta vs. required FTE/burst-hours).

KEY ASSUMPTIONS (base values):
- Base revenue run-rate (hosted API & dedicated): $46,000,000 ARR
- Average price per 1k tokens (effective blended): $0.70 per 1k tokens
- Baseline unit cost per 1k tokens (infra + amortized SRE/ops): $0.22 per 1k tokens
- GPU burst rate (spot/equivalent): $1.80 per GPU-hour, average of 6k tokens per GPU-hour when serving real-time; batchable workloads cheaper by 2.5x
- Contingent overlay pool: up to 12 FTEs (mix of infra eng, inference eng, solutions eng), 6 months average ramp to full productivity
- Average loaded cost per overlay FTE: $220,000 FY fully-loaded
- Deal-tranche conversion probabilities used: qualification (30%), advanced (60%), signature (90%)

SHEET LOGIC SUMMARY:
- Each scenario computes incremental ARR credited to overlay hires and burst-hours, then subtracts incremental costs (FTE pro-rated ramp, burst infra hours, additional storage/KMS) to compute net incremental contribution margin.
- Pricing sensitivity: we re-run the scenario for price +/- 20% in 5% increments and compute required overlay FTE (or FTE reduction) to maintain a target contribution margin (set at 38% for the exercise).
- Outcome: trigger rules expressed as a matrix: if expected deal ARR > X and price delta <= Y then authorize Z overlay FTE and W burst-hours/month for N months.

INTERPRETATION NOTES:
- At -20% price move, the overlay loses money in this mid-sized tranche unless we reduce overlay hires by ~40% or secure longer-term commit pricing.
- At base pricing, small overlay funding is marginally positive but sensitive to faster ramp assumptions and upsell timelines.
- At +20% pricing (or if deals compress more MRR into larger predictable yearly commits), overlay is very attractive.

TRIGGER MATRIX (draft):
- If qualified pipeline (probability-weighted) for next 6 months > $2.5M, authorize 4 overlay FTE + 12k GPU-hours/month for 6 months.
- If qualified pipeline between $1.2M-$2.5M, authorize 2 overlay FTE + 6k GPU-hours/month but require pricing to be within -10% of baseline or better.
- If price moves worse than -15%, freeze overlay hiring and reroute to internal reprioritization; sales to pursue non-discounted recurring commitments only.

RISKS & MITIGATIONS:
- Risk: slower-than-expected hiring/ramp. Mitigation: prefer 6-month contractor bench for first 6 hires, convert to perm only on signed commitments.
- Risk: hidden infra costs from tail latencies. Mitigation: require SRE checkpoint and real-time cost dashboard population before any second tranche hires.
- Risk: sales pushes aggressive discounts. Mitigation: require finance pre-approval for >10% off-lists on enterprise overlay-enabled deals.

ACTION ITEMS (next steps):
- Finance to produce a simple dashboard widget for "overlay burn" (real-time burn vs approved allowance) by 2026-04-01 — owner: Samir Gupta
- Go/no-go gating: define two person sign-off (Head of Sales + Head of Finance) for any overlay hires beyond 6 FTEs — owner: Priya Nair
- Run a contractor pricing sweep and candidate pipeline; cost delta expected +/-10% on loaded contract rates — owner: Diego Alvarez

NOTES TO REVIEWERS:
- This is intentionally conservative on token throughput per GPU-hour (6k) for real-time; if engineering improvements push to 9–12k tokens/hr the economics shift significantly.
- Spreadsheet tabs (not exported here): assumptions, hire-schedule, price-sensitivity-runner, trigger-matrix, dashboard-mockup.

END
